purpose: Teach: 共鳴/下院/壊滅/縄文/半減/弾道/受益/書簡

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、心と体の共鳴を医療チームで重視しております
lines.en: Ren, we place a great deal of emphasis on the connection between mind and body across our entire medical team.
lines.style: Clear, measured delivery. Steady eye contact. Professional warmth without distance. Each phrase lands with quiet authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 米国下院での医療法案、貴院、注目されておられますね、先生
lines.en: The medical bill being discussed in the U.S. House—your hospital has been getting a lot of attention for it, hasn't it, sensei?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, not performative. Slight lean forward. Respectful but engaged—this is a real question, not formality.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、感染症で壊滅状態だった病院を、医療チームで再建支援しました
lines.en: Yes. We helped rebuild and support a hospital that had been devastated by infectious disease outbreak. It was a coordinated effort across the whole team.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, without self-congratulation. Slight pause after 'Yes'—acknowledging the weight of what's being described. Steady, honest delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 縄文時代の遺骨からの病理解析、貴院も研究なさったんですね、先生
lines.en: The pathological analysis from Jomon-period skeletal remains—your hospital was involved in that research too, weren't you, sensei?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slower pace. Respectful wonder—he's genuinely impressed but expressing it quietly. Slight trailing question mark.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、感染者数を半減させる対策を医療チームで実施しました
lines.en: Yes. We implemented measures across the medical team that reduced infection rates by half. It took coordinated effort and careful planning.
lines.style: Steady, factual. No inflation in tone. Slight emphasis on 'half'—the concrete result speaks. Calm professional pride.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 銃弾の弾道分析、貴院でも対応されたんですね、先生
lines.en: Ballistic analysis of bullet wounds—your hospital responded to those cases as well, didn't you, sensei?
lines.style: Same thoughtful register as before, but slightly quieter. Ren noticing something serious and responding with appropriate gravity.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療受益者の支援も医療チームで行います
lines.en: Yes. We also provide support to the beneficiaries of medical care—that's work our team handles together as well.
lines.style: Composed, broadening the scope slightly. Still measured. A gentle reminder that the work extends beyond clinical care to human support.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 歴史的医学書簡を、貴院、保存されておられますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital preserves historical medical correspondence and documents, doesn't it, sensei?
lines.style: Quieter, more reflective close. Ren drawing the conversation toward something more contemplative. Respectful, almost wondering tone.
